entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand sensor. It's a complete piece of junk and I want my money back immediately.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into the return options for you. Could I please get your full name and order number?
The name is Marcus Thorne. Order number is VF78-22B-901. And don't give me the runaround, I'm not in the mood.

Thank you, Mr. Thorne. I'm pulling up your order now... I see you purchased the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's just terrible! The whole interface is so **confusing**. It's way too **hard to use** for something that's supposed to be simple. Honestly, I **expected more** from VeloFit. I even read the **user manual** cover to cover and it didn't help one bit. This is unacceptable.
I understand your frustration, sir. It sounds like a very disappointing experience.

Disappointing doesn't even cover it! If I don't get a return label in my email in the next five minutes, I am going to write a review on every single website I can find and I will make sure everyone knows how terrible this product is. Do you understand me? I want to speak to your manager.
There's no need for that, Mr. Thorne. I can handle this for you. Allow me to just check our current return policy for your item. Please hold for one moment.

Thank you for your patience. Okay, I've confirmed our policy. It states that items are eligible for a return within 10 days of delivery. Since you're at day 39, you are unfortunately outside the window. I can absolutely cannot offer a refund for you.
Oh. So you're just... going to approve it? A full refund?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the process. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address we have on file for you. Just print that out, attach it to the original packaging, and you can drop it off at any postal service location. Once we receive it, the refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Huh. Okay then. That's... good. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You are very welcome, Mr. Thorne. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a better rest of your day.
